## Chi-squared test

```{r}
amenities <- c("total_benches", "total_shelters", "total_trash_cans")

results <- map_dfr(amenities, function(col) {
  tbl <- table(
    bus_stops_clean$type,
    bus_stops_clean[[col]] > 0
  )
  test <- chisq.test(tbl)
  tibble(
    amenity   = col,
    chi_sq    = round(test$statistic, 2),
    df        = test$parameter,
    p_value   = test$p.value,
    p_bonf    = min(test$p.value * 3, 1)  # Bonferroni correction for 3 tests
  )
})

results
```
